ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( AND( TEXT(Stage__c) != 'Pending Student Confirmation', TEXT(Stage__c) != 'Visa In Progress', TEXT(Stage__c) != 'Pending Arrival', TEXT(Stage__c) != 'Arrived', TEXT(Stage__c) != 'Commission Received', TEXT(Stage__c) != 'Commission Paid', TEXT(Stage__c) != 'Reject' ), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Offer__c))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: IF Offer exist then Stage should be either 'Pending Student Confirmation', 'Visa In Progress', 'Pending Arrival', 'Arrived', 'Commission Received','Reject' or 'Commission Paid'
